Subject: Xavier Gomez — interview debrief & next steps

Hi Jonas / Laura — quick notes from today’s 45-minute interview with Xavier (Thu 3/12 09:00 PST slot confirmed earlier):

Context: 45m technical + cultural; Jonas led questions on runtime/kernel behavior, Laura covered system design and team fit.

What went well:
- Strong depth on cache eviction strategies and KV-cache management; presented a concrete perf regression story with measured latency improvement (18% p99)
- Clear trade-off thinking about batching vs tail latency; good instinct for graceful degradation
- Positive communication style and asked thoughtful clarifying questions

Concerns / follow-ups:
- Limited exposure to our specific GPU memory optimizations; has theoretical familiarity but not hands-on with our custom kernels
- Wanted a short follow-up interview with someone from Serving Runtime team (deep kernel/quantization questions) — recommend scheduling a 60m deep-dive with Mina or Hiro if we want to validate kernel-level experience

Recommendation: Move to a technical deep-dive (60m) with Serving Runtime engineer + hiring manager to validate kernel/quantization knowledge. If that goes well, we can proceed to an offer discussion.

Sofia — please confirm Xavier’s continued interest and his flexibility for a 60-minute slot next week.

Jonas — are you available early next week (Mon/Tue mornings PST) for the deep-dive? If not, flag an alternate interviewer and we’ll coordinate.

Thanks,
Marissa
Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
